how: Generated by scripts/gen_brotli_reference.ps1 with .NET BrotliEncoder.TryCompress, quality 1, window 22. Do not edit by hand.

generator.prng: xorshift64: s ^= s << 13; s ^= s >> 7; s ^= s << 17; byte = (s >> 32) & 0xFF
generator.seed: buffer at position i in the list is seeded with 0x123456789ABCDEF0 + i
generator.text: the phrase "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. " repeated from its start at the run start

shapes.longrange-64KiB-x4: a 64 KiB PRNG block repeated four times (WP17 longrange shape)
shapes.block-mix-P: first P percent of the buffer PRNG bytes, the rest zeros
shapes.alpha-M: every byte is a PRNG byte modulo M
shapes.interleaved-9of10: 4 KiB blocks; block number mod 10 = 9 is zeros, the others PRNG bytes
shapes.head-text-12: first 12 percent repeated phrase, the rest PRNG bytes
